source_pins.role: Canonical Certifier package stewardship and downstream authority separation
Existing canonical certification and downstream references; historical source facts
Registry Founder/steward authority option and evidence/decision record obligations
Registry-created SREG governed by separate creation/registrability
Registrant eligibility distinct from source authority and validation
Schema of completed SREG; not machine intake contract

options.name: Maintain existing human-governed historical reference only
options.effect: Keep canonical existing SC-CERT and SREG references with existing authority and source-owned meanings; do not adopt a new machine protocol
requires: No new owner adoption needed for treating historical existing records as historical facts
Any new downstream interpretation or record action still separately governed

options.name: Approve documentary read-only source-reference profile
options.effect: A narrowly defined consumer profile containing full issuer identity, canonical URL, source version-at-use, captured-at time, issuer status as quoted source fact, and provenance evidence. No issuance endpoint, automated live lookup, or currentness claim.
requires: Registry owner acceptance of this read-only consumption profile
Explicit schema and source-version semantics; stale/unknown/unavailable refusal
Versioned governance decision by actual authorized roles

options.name: Approve automatic Registry receiving or creation API
options.effect: Authenticated integration with potentially privileged Registry actions, idempotency, durable audit, decision and publication controls
requires: Close D-2A-01/02/03/05/06 with approved owner evidence
Independent authenticated nonproduction testing and fault-recovery evidence
